comments.text: to solve one of the issues, why not simply make the drones deliever to a public pickup station? in Europe we have those things called a "packstation", that are essentially a bunch of "mailboxes", when u want to pick up a package u simply go to one of these, input ur pick up code, and it opens the box with ur specific package, normally these packstations are supplied by ppl in delievery vans, but why not make them drones? simply make these packstations very close to each other, so u get as much covarage as u can, and install a sort of docking port atop the packstation for the drones, then the machine scans the packages, and dispenses your package when u type in ur code
